title: Jelly-Filled Canadian Cod Chowder
description: A creamy, pescatarian-friendly Canadian dish featuring Canadian cod, custard, and jelly. Bitter notes come from dark roux.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine 250ml dashi broth, 120ml whole milk, 60g flour, and 30g cold butter. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until mixture thickens to a bechamel.
Add 450g Canadian cod fillets to the saucepan and cook until cod flakes easily with a fork.
In a blender or food processor, puree 2 leeks and 3 cloves garlic until smooth.
Add puree to the saucepan and cook for 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine 60g sugar, 1g sodium alginate, and 250ml water.
Bring mixture to a boil, then remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Using a siphon or whipping siphon, whip mixture until stiff peaks form.
Add 4 large egg yolks to the whipped mixture and whip until smooth.
Add whipped mixture to the saucepan and cook until custard thickens, stirring constantly.
Transfer the mixture to a blender or food processor and puree until smooth.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and add 5g dark soy sauce.
